description: The bar chart titled “NDCG@10” illustrates NDCG@10 values for four categories shown along the horizontal axis, with category labels displayed at an angle: an unlabeled first category (represented by an orange bar), followed by “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking” (represented by blue bars). The vertical axis is a linear numeric scale with tick marks from approximately 0.05 up to 0.25 at regular 0.05 intervals. The first (orange) bar reaches about 0.21, the “- critiquing” blue bar is about 0.19, the “- scoring” blue bar is about 0.07–0.08, and the “- ranking” blue bar is about 0.12. The bars are presented as a single series (not grouped or stacked), with no visible legend, and there are no annotations or special emphasis beyond the distinct orange color used for the first bar; the categories do not appear to be sorted by value.
